afterburner: A high-intensity class that pushes EPOC (excess post-oxygen consumption) so that your body keeps working even after the session has finished.
bjj fundamentals: Learning the fundamental positions, movements and techniques of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. A grappling based martial art which uses takedowns, throws, pins and submissions to combat your opponent. This class is ideal for those new to Jiu Jitsu and grappling.
bjj intermediateadvanced: For White Belts 3 stripes up to Black Belts. Develop a complete, individualized game. Learn advanced and modern techniques through detailed explanations and demonstrations. Take part in positional, situational and live sparring.
bjj intro: Brand new to Brazilian jiu-jitsu? Start with our introductory class for White Belts. Learn the rules of the sport, health and safety when training, dojo etiquette and basic terminology, positions and movement drills.
boxing: Take your boxing skills to the next level. You will learn not only how to punch the pads, but also how to hold them. This is a more advanced class which will incorporate footwork, head movement, and complex combinations.
boxing fundamentals: Learn boxing fundamentals. Beginners will be taught the correct stance, the precise technique for punches, and effective boxing movements. Advanced boxers will improve their form and progress their technique.
contrast therapy: Boost your mental resilience and physical recovery in this guided contrast therapy session. Relax in the sauna with calming breathwork and gentle stretching, then challenge yourself in the cold plunge to build focus and clarity.
core: A strong and functional core is fundamental for all training. This class uses full body movements in multiple planes to fully engage your core building strength, stability and balance as well as shaping your abdominals.
dynamic mat pilates: Dynamic Pilates takes classical Pilates principles and applies them to functional movements to support and challenge the body.
dynamic reformer: Minimal rest, maximum results. Increase the tempo in this advanced reformer class.
engine endurance: Built to develop your aerobic fitness and lasting stamina. Expect longer efforts held at a controlled sustainable pace. Combining functional weighted movement with assault bikes, ski ergs, rowers.
engine intervals: Built to push your top-end fitness through short bursts of high-intensity work. Using functional weighted movement alongside assault bikes, ski ergs, rowers and targeted conditioning.
force: A music driven barbell and dumbbell class designed to fatigue the whole body through higher repetitions creating muscular endurance. A great class for those new to weights or experienced lifters who want to feel the burn.
formula 3: This is the Formula to get you fit, fast. A competitive, high intensity circuit with 3 targeted blocks, for a full spectrum workout. First, cardio on Concept2 rowing machines; Second, strength with kettlebells and dumbbells; Finally, athletic power and speed with bodyweight exercises.
fundamental reformer pilates: No experience necessary. Whether you're a Reformer beginner, healing from an injury, or want a slower class, start building your foundation here.
hatha yoga: New to yoga? This is the class for you. Move at a slower pace to focus on each posture and alignment using pranayama - or conscious breathing exercises.
hot yoga: Enter stretches and postures, deeply and safely. A hot environment keeps muscles warm and supple, while boosting blood circulation and detoxify through perspiration.
hyrox 90: Develop your functional fitness to become the ultimate hybrid athlete and train to take part in a Hyrox fitness race event. Learn and improve exercise techniques to make every rep count.
hyrox engine: Build your race-day engine. This class combines high-volume running, erg work, and functional strength to boost both aerobic endurance and anaerobic power.
hyrox power: Build strength, endurance, and explosive power while fine-tuning your technique. Stay strong under pressure and dominate every station.
hyrox run: Simulate the demands of fitness racing, combining muscular fatigue with interval running on the treadmill. Strength and power-based movements replace recovery between intervals to compromise your next run and improve cardiovascular endurance.
hyrox train: Develop your functional fitness to become the ultimate hybrid athlete and train to take part in a Hyrox fitness race event. Learn and improve exercise techniques to make every rep count.
just ride: Switch off. Just Ride. Tempo cardio intervals with climbs and sprints. Lose yourself in the music.
kettlebells: A dynamic full-body workout designed to boost core strength and enhance muscular endurance. A variety of kettlebell exercises target every major muscle group, helping you build power while shredding body fat.
lga: Legs, Glutes and Abs. Working some of the largest muscles in the body to create a high calorie burn. Expect a combination of strength and high intensity explosive exercises, aimed at increasing strength and flexibility.
lift: Create a strong, athletic and powerful body using progressively heavier weights under the careful instruction of your trainer.
mat pilates fundamentals: A slower-paced class that emphasises precise instruction, with a strong focus on proper alignment and posture improvement.
metaburn: A pyramid style, full body metabolic conditioning workout. Strengthen your body using resistance exercises interspersed with high intensity plyometric moves, building intensity throughout the workout.
muay thai: Bringing all your skills together, hone your all-around fighting style to include counter-attacks, ring awareness and situational training in a controlled technical sparring environment.
pulse: Set to the beat of the music, this low-impact barre workout uses ballet and Pilates-inspired isometric strength training techniques.
rocket yoga: Fast and strong. Rooted in Ashtanga Vinyasa yoga, this challenging and playful practice incorporates inversions, arm balances, back-bends and standing balances to powerful, upbeat music.
run club: Get out of the gym and onto the streets with a coached group run.
skills drills: A front crawl focused session with varying skills and drills, concentrating on: the Catch, Push, Pull and recovery elements of your stroke.
sound bath: Lose yourself in deep relaxation and meditation. A unique soundscape of gongs, crystal bowls and percussion instruments will leave you feeling calm and rejuvenated.
speed fiends: Unlock your full running potential with focused interval training on the treadmill. Tailored to your individual pace and level, this 45-minute cardio-intensive class has an expert coach on hand to offer motivation and guidance on your running form.
strong: Strength training with purpose. Our 12-week progressive programme combines barbells, cables and functional movement to help you build confidence, move better and get stronger in every direction.
sweat x: Sweat with a purpose as you split the time equally between running and strength on and off the treadmill. Torch calories, build endurance and unleash your strength in this high intensity class set to an incredible playlist.
the method: A barre-based full-body workout, set to energising music. Suitable to all, including newbies and pre and post-natal members.
the wod: Your Workout of the Day. Inspired by cross training, expect EMOMs and AMRAPs as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard.
tower pilates: Traditional Tower Pilates classes are an authentic blend of classical Pilates exercises and contemporary variations.
traditional reformer pilates: Using spring tension to support and challenge you, expect to stretch, strengthen and tone in this full-body workout.
triathlon swim training: A coached, water based session focusing on technique, swim specific fitness and open water skills to enhance an athlete's triathlon or open water performance.
trx: Challenge your muscular and cardiovascular systems with controlled lifting protocols and finish with high energy metabolic conditioning work.
vinyasa yoga: Each class is unique, guided by the teacher's individual style and training, offering a steady, but faster-paced flow.
wattbike: Our Wattbike class replicates a real ride feel and delivers an unrivalled experience. With targeted effective programming and the ability to analyse your technique, maximise your performance and redefine your training.
womens selfdefence: Practical self-defence skills drawn from Brazilian Jiu Jitsu: takedowns, throws, pins and escapes, taught for real situations.
yard strong: Strongman challenges in a stadium atmosphere: it's a strength class like no other. Expect log bars, farmer carries and more across 4 stations.
yard wod: Your Workout of the Day in The Yard. Inspired by cross training, expect EMOMs and AMRAPs as standard and be prepared to dig deep and push hard.
yin yoga: Slow and meditative, Yin Yoga promotes flexibility, relaxation and energy flow by applying gentle, sustained pressure.
